symptom: Upgrading an mxcli-built project 11.16.0 -> 11.16.1 with `mx convert --in-place` rewrote 428 units; 5 differed by a key the converter ADDED: `Attribute: ""` on a Microflows$ValidationFeedbackAction bound to an association, `OffsetExpression: ""` on the Microflows$CustomRange of a `retrieve … limit n` with no offset, and `MemberAccesses: [3]` (empty list, marker 3) on a DomainModels$AccessRule with no member entries. mx check clean; the documents are unmergeable once Studio Pro saves them (mendixlabs/mxcli#1373 class)
cause: Three (type, key) gaps the measured table behind canon.CompletePropertySets did not cover: the writers emit only the populated half of Attribute/Association (microflow_write.go ValidationFeedbackAction), set OffsetExpression only when non-empty (rangeToGen), and the gen PartList omits an empty MemberAccesses (accessRuleToGen, domainmodel_alter, domainmodel_security_write). The doctype corpus measured for the table never wrote these shapes
insight: **A version upgrade is a free property-set measurement on a real project**: `mx convert` between patch versions rewrites every unit, and after ignoring key ORDER (423 of 428 units) whatever keys remain added are exactly the gaps, with Mendix's value and BSON type (string vs null, list marker) — read them from the before/after commit, not from intuition. The doctype corpus misses shapes no corpus script writes (feedback on an association, limit without offset, a rule with no members), so a real app finds rows the corpus cannot. **The table holds empty lists too** (`{"v":[{"$numberInt":"3"}]}`), so a missing empty list is a row, not a writer change; and since it only adds an absent key, a rule WITH members, a feedback WITH an attribute and a range WITH an offset are untouched (controls in the test). since=10.24.0: the reflection data (gen VersionInfos) gives none of the three keys an Introduced, and it is the neighbouring rows' floor. Not fixed: the issue's DatabaseConnection `Queries` marker (converter 3, mxcli 2) — no Studio Pro-written DatabaseConnection exists in testdata or ChatV2's history (every committed revision holds 2), so there is nothing to measure it against; and CustomRange.LimitExpression on an offset-only retrieve has the same shape of gap but no measurement
test: `go test ./mdl/backend/modelsdk/ -run TestIssue2256` — encodes each element through the writer's converter and canon.CompleteForStorage at 11.16.1, asserts the converter's key set and value; fails on the three subjects with the table rows removed, controls pass both ways
